visualCharacteristics.structure: grid of linked cards (4 per row on desktop): image, uppercase title, single-line truncated description

contentPattern: One row per card: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = linked title (strong/heading) + description paragraph. Option 'filter': cell 3 = comma-separated categories (may be empty); block renders an 'All' + alphabetical category filter bar above the grid and hides non-matching cards.
